content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The solution to this problem lies in sovereign digital commerce stacks, which provide a complete set of tools for creators to sell their products without relying on restricted platforms. This approach is not just a workaround, but a robust infrastructure that gives creators full ownership and control over their sales process. By using free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, creators can deploy their own online stores with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to be efficient and cost-effective. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. For file delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is used, while NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a low fee of 0.5%. This setup allows creators to sell their products without incurring high platform fees, such as the 10% charged by Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who are locked out of conventional payment platforms, including those in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. It's also for creators who want to maintain full ownership and control over their sales process, without relying on third-party platforms that can change their terms and fees at any time. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can ensure that they receive the full amount of their sales, without any deductions or restrictions.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks provide full ownership and control over the sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work together seamlessly to provide a robust and efficient sales process. For example, NOWPayments integrates with the backend logic to verify crypto payments automatically, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the delivery of digital products. The use of Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage ensures that all sales data is securely stored and easily accessible. By combining these components, creators can deploy a fully functional online store that meets their needs and those of their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by choosing the components that best fit their needs. They can then follow a step-by-step guide to set up their online store, including configuring the backend logic, integrating with NOWPayments, and testing the sales process. With the right guidance and support, creators can have their online store up and running in no time, and start selling their digital products to customers around the world.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments. This approach allows for automatic payment verification and instant product delivery, without incurring high platform fees. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments retains $921, which can be a significant amount for creators.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10%.

This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, and is worth $348 separately. To learn more and purchase the kit, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Choose the components that best fit your needs, including hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. Set up your online store and configure the backend logic. Integrate with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Test the sales process to ensure everything is working smoothly. Deploy your online store and start selling your digital products to customers around the world. Monitor and optimize your sales process to ensure maximum efficiency and profitability.
